Composition & Indication

Amlodipine 10mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Norvasc®) contains Amlodipine Besylate 10 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Tablets at the official 10mg strength. The standard indication is the management of high blood pressure and chest pain (angina), per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Amlodipine 10mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
